# ToolForge ATS Resume Checker

> ToolForge is a free, 100% private in-browser ATS (Applicant Tracking System) resume scanner, keyword matcher, and bullet point optimizer. All document parsing and text analysis run client-side in browser memory with zero server uploads.

## Core Capabilities
- **27-Point ATS Diagnostic Audit**: Checks formatting, font safety, table avoidance, section heading standardization, contact info placement, and file parsing integrity.
- **Job Description Keyword Matcher**: Compares candidate resumes against target job descriptions, identifying matching skills, missing keywords, and frequency gaps.
- **Google X-Y-Z Bullet Polisher**: Rewrites weak responsibilities into high-impact metric bullets following Google's hiring formula: "Accomplished [X], as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]".
- **Workday & Greenhouse Parser Verification**: Simulates how enterprise parsers extract candidate work experience, skills, and education.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Resumes are parsed locally using Web Workers. Zero bytes of candidate data are sent to servers or third-party APIs.

## Key URLs
